title: Timucua archived analysis source audit

findings.finding: The code counts 5 assessable criteria but requires 6 for the strong tier. That branch is unreachable; no candidate can receive this tier.
findings.recommended_resolution: Decide and document whether strong requires all assessable criteria or whether additional criteria must be adjudicated. Do not silently lower the threshold: C5/C6 are explicitly unassessed and this is a scientific decision.

findings.finding: The source embeds an environment-specific absolute fallback for external datasets. The pipeline is portable only when TIMUCUA_EXT is explicitly set.
findings.recommended_resolution: Use a repository-relative default while retaining TIMUCUA_EXT override.

findings.finding: The addendum source-check script explicitly recomputes the H1 absent count because the frozen H1 output contains -6 from bitwise inversion of an object column.
findings.recommended_resolution: Keep the corrected count as the cited value and retain the frozen output only for audit history.

scope: Static source inspection only; no linguistic result or preregistered hypothesis is changed.
